definitions.explanation: Waste materials produced by metabolism in the body, such as urea, carbon dioxide, and toxins, that need to be eliminated. Common in health, fitness, and beauty contexts.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}は{老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}の{排出|はいしゅつ}を{促|うなが}す。
examples.english: Exercise promotes the elimination of waste products.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}をたくさん{飲|の}むと{老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}が{体|からだ}から{出|で}やすくなる。
examples.english: Drinking plenty of water makes it easier for waste products to leave the body.

examples.japanese: リンパマッサージは{体内|たいない}にたまった{老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}を{流|なが}す{効果|こうか}があるとされる。
examples.english: Lymphatic massage is said to have the effect of flushing out waste products that have built up in the body.

notes:
Compound of {老廃|ろうはい} (worn-out and discarded) + {物|ぶつ} (substance). Standard term in health, nutrition, and beauty discussions for metabolic byproducts that should be excreted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}を{排出|はいしゅつ}する: to excrete waste products
- {老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}がたまる: waste products build up
- {老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}を{流|なが}す: to flush out waste products
- {体内|たいない}の{老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}: waste products in the body

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {排泄物|はいせつぶつ}: excrement, excreta — the actually excreted matter (urine, feces)
- {毒素|どくそ}: toxins — harmful substances generally
- {廃棄物|はいきぶつ}: waste matter (industrial/general) — not biological
